meta.note: Offline starting point, NOT quotes and NOT a yield. Every id, ticker and asset name here is a real CoinGecko-listed asset. Prices, market caps, volumes, percentage changes and ATH levels are approximate round figures for 2026-08-01, hand-set to be plainly reasonable rather than precise. Nothing on these rows pays anything: spot crypto has no yield, and the range shown in the app is computed from the volatility below by the same code that runs after a live refresh. Refresh to replace every figure with a measured one.

fields.snapshotStats: BUNDLED-SNAPSHOT-ONLY field; the live API does not return it. volAnnualised is an approximate annualised volatility in percent and volRatio is the recent-vs-baseline volatility ratio. Live rows measure both from the 168-point hourly sparkline instead. A hand-authored 168-point price path would be a fabricated price history, which is worse than a figure openly labelled an estimate.
fields.high_24h: Set so that the Parkinson range estimator reproduces roughly the stated volatility, keeping the fallback path and the snapshot path consistent with each other.
fields.ath_change_percentage: Negative, as CoinGecko reports it: percent BELOW the all-time high.
